summary: Iter 232c MobileBottomNav: frontend-only regression complete. Bottom nav renders correctly at 390x844, hides on desktop ≥768px, hides on /login, navigates Home/Matchup/Team/Home tabs successfully, More button opens Shadcn sidebar drawer, active tab carries aria-current='page' with cyan #00D2FF color, presence bubble correctly null-renders (Socket.IO 403 in preview env as expected per iter 130), AppLayout main has pb-20 (80px) on mobile preventing content occlusion, safe-area class `pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]` is applied. Desktop sidebar regression confirmed (width=255). One transient test-flake on chat-tab tap (URL did not change from /matchup → /chat on first attempt; direct page.goto to /chat works fine — Test 11 confirmed /chat renders the chat-presence-bar). Likely a Playwright click-vs-navigate timing issue, not a product bug.

integration_issues.issue: Single observed instance where clicking [data-testid=mobile-bottom-nav-chat] from /matchup did not change URL to /chat in time (URL stayed /matchup). Subsequent taps to /team and /dashboard worked. /chat itself is reachable (confirmed via direct navigation in Test 11, which found chat-presence-bar mounted). Most likely a Playwright timing flake; main agent does NOT need to fix unless reproducible on real devices.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.jsx is 143 lines, well under the 700-line cap — fine.
Component correctly uses the shared useLeagueSocket singleton (no second socket connection).

Header comment claims component is hidden 'when no active league is selected' but the code does not actually return null in that case — it just shows the bubble at 0. Cosmetic doc mismatch, not a bug.
Tab navigation uses <Link> from react-router-dom (good — client-side routing, no full reload). active state uses location.pathname.startsWith which correctly catches nested routes like /team/123.
